sentences.en: An atom is made out of protons, neutrons and electrons.
sentences.zh: 一个原子由质子、中子和电子组成。

sentences.en: An hydrogen atom only has one proton and one electron.
sentences.zh: 一个氢原子只有一个质子和一个电子。

sentences.en: The atom's nucleus is surrounded by an electron cloud.
sentences.zh: 原子的核被一层电子云包围。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：electr（电）+on（物质结构成分）→电子
